Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 dummy VARCHAR2(1);
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.dup_contract := '';
 :GLOBAL.no_contract := '';
 
 SELECT SUBSTR(company,1,28)
 ,center_id
 INTO :control_block.company
 ,:control_block.center_id
 FROM contracts
 WHERE contract_id = :control_block.contract_id AND 
 --chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id AND 
 LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id , :control_block.chapter_id) = 'Y' AND -- SOUKUM 06192018 MLT-249
 contract_type = 'RG' AND 
 --SYSDATE between eff_date AND nvl(term_date,SYSDATE+365) -- SCR 18938
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,SYSDATE+365) AND 
 EXISTS 
 (
 SELECT 'x' 
 FROM rgt_result_parms
 WHERE chapter_id = contracts.chapter_id AND 
 contract_id = contracts.contract_id AND 
 ROWNUM = 1
 ) AND ROWNUM = 1
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 :GLOBAL.dup_contract := 'Y';
 show_error('1060');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 :GLOBAL.no_contract := 'Y';
 show_error('1147');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 then
 handle_error;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 dummy VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 /* trigger to get the COUNT of batches between the dates */
 /* AND thus check for the validity of the dates */
 BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.batches_found := '';
 
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO :control_block.total
 FROM rgt_result_parms
 WHERE chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id AND 
 contract_id = :control_block.contract_id AND 
 (
 --TRUNC(insert_dats) -- SCR 18938
 --TRUNC(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,insert_dats)) 
 --BETWEEN :control_block.from_date AND :control_block.to_date 
 --lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,:control_block.from_date,:control_block.to_date,insert_dats) = 'Y' -- Commented by Kishore on 08/26/2015. IM 86
 trunc(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, insert_dats)) 
 between :control_block.from_date AND :control_block.to_date -- Added by Kishore on 08/26/2015. IM 86
 ) AND 
 EXISTS 
 (
 SELECT 'x' 
 FROM units 
 WHERE EXISTS 
 ( 
 SELECT 'x' 
 FROM utrs 
 WHERE utrs.unit_id = units.unit_id AND 
 TRUNC(utrs.coll_date) = units.coll_date AND 
 NVL(utrs.extract_date,sysdate) = rgt_result_parms.insert_dats
 ) AND 
 units.batch_id = rgt_result_parms.batch_id AND
 units.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 )
 ;

 :GLOBAL.batches_found := 'Y';
 
 IF :control_block.total = 0 
 THEN
 :GLOBAL.batches_found := 'N';
 show_error('1072');
 check_package_failure;
 END if;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND 
 THEN
 show_error('1072');
 :GLOBAL.batches_found := 'N';
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS 
 THEN
 NULL;
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
/* To get the interim results from the QC interim for every unit */
/* */
 begin
 
 if :utrs.result_status_1 is null then
 select result_code
 into :utrs.interim
 from rgt_interim_results
 where unit_id = :utrs.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id
 and contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 and coll_date = :utrs.coll_date
 and test_id = :utrs.test_id
 and test_seq_no = :utrs.test_seq_no
 and nvl(extract_flag,'N') = 'Y';
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
/* Get the QC date from Units table , when the Unit was QCed last */
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CONTROL_BLO_CONTRACT_ID_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select contract_id,substr(company,1,28),center_id
from contracts
where LAB_COMMON.CHECK_CONTRACT_CHAPTER(contract_id , :control_block.chapter_id) = 'Y' 
and (upper(company) like upper('%'||:contract_id||'%') or (contract_id like '%'||:contract_id||'%'))
and contract_type = 'RG'
and Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
and exists (select 'x' from rgt_result_parms where chapter_id = contracts.chapter_id and contract_id = contracts.contract_id) order by contract_id
